statement: Create new content in project management with "Add Asset Library"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Remove or clear content in project management with "Remove Asset Library"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Use "Close Project" in project management; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.
Write document content to disk or pack it into the file in project management with "Save Project Config"; reading it back reproduces the same content, and failures leave the previous file intact.

Create new content in project management with "New Project"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Bring content into the document in project management with "Open Project..."; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Remove or clear content in project management with "Clear Splash Artwork"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in project management with "Create Splash Artwork"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Create new content in project management with "Add Variable"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in project management with "Move Variable"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.

Remove or clear content in project management with "Remove Variable"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
